field_principles.field_principles: Field principles keep the artifact schema tied to the operator's stated audit reason.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every reachability and selection field must point to run rows, code hashes, and reducer logic.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked result must name the missing live path, receipt, or input check and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict must state live reachability, firing support, and policy disposition with a terminal prefix.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Receipt tracing and decision replay invoke no LLM and no offline solver.
field_principles.live_entrypoint_reachability_receipt: Only code reachable from E3AgentPolicy or make_carnot_agent can improve the hidden-game deliverable.
field_principles.no_firing_run_rows: An empty ledger is a valid measured state and must not force churn.
field_principles.no_solve_and_no_source_receipt: The task must prove that it read no game source, used no per-game adapter, and claimed no level solve.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Every run, firing, arm, and outcome disposition must remain recheckable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Code, schema, artifact, registry, and resource receipts separate a block from no firings.
field_principles.prior_failure_receipt: The artifact must show how the Exp6524 missing-outcome block was tested.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The ARC task must preserve the active roadmap and conductor.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed audit and replay order makes receipt analysis repeatable.
field_principles.redirect_to_next_outcome_rows: Each firing must link to its next exact observed outcome without reassignment.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A final hash protects the generalization determination trail.
field_principles.selection_policy_disposition: The record must say changed, unchanged, or future-arm-specification and why.
field_principles.status: A terminal state lets no-firing and missing-receipt outcomes satisfy the standing ARC slot honestly.
field_principles.supervisor_receipt_schema_and_code_hashe: Exact schema and implementation identities prevent a test-only receipt path from posing as live.
field_principles.tests_run: Named ARC lint, unit, and E2E receipts show the shared live path was checked.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents an unsupported or blocked refinement from becoming positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Supervisor outcomes are live observations, not an oracle-distinct EBM verifier.
